personality_one_liner: A sharp, reactive, and highly legible command-center that prioritizes fast scanning and immediate hierarchy, illuminated by a warm amber accent.

spacing.rule: Generous intentional padding around content, clear grouping of related elements. Empty space is content but on purpose. Use 16px padding on edges.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary and tonal separation instead of blur due to the high density of metrics.
dont's: Avoid heavy blur that reduces readability of dense data screens.

screens.name: Beranda (Home)
screens.purpose: Dashboard overview providing quick summaries and actions for all modules.

states.empty: Should always display structural cards (Finance balance, Today's tasks). Show empty illustrations inside the cards if no data.
states.error: Card-level error state with retry button

screens.layout: Vertical stack layout. Top: Welcome + Date. Section 1: Finance Summary (Balance + miniature trend line). Section 2: 'Hari Ini' (Today) displaying combined active Reminders/Alarms and pending Tasks. Section 3: Quick access chips to Vault and Files.

screens.name: Keuangan (Finance)
screens.purpose: Detailed tracking of income, expenses, and category-wise charts.

states.empty: Illustration of abstract finance dashboard + 'Belum ada transaksi' + Add button.

screens.layout: Top: Segmented control (Income / Expense). Below: Large balance metric using condensed typography. Middle: Bar/Pie chart for categories. Bottom: List of recent transactions with high-contrast amounts (Success for Income, Error/Surface Inverse for Expense). Sticky bottom CTA to log a transaction.

screens.name: Jadwal (Schedule)
screens.purpose: Calendar events, alarms, and tasks managed in a timeline.

states.empty: Notepad illustration + 'Tidak ada jadwal hari ini' + Add button.

screens.layout: Top: Horizontal week calendar. Middle: Segmented control (Jadwal, Tugas, Alarm). Bottom: Chronological feed of items. Alarms have a toggle switch. Tasks have a checkbox. Sticky bottom FAB (+).

screens.name: Brankas (Vault)
screens.purpose: Secure PIN-locked access to passwords and files.

states.empty: Empty folder illustration + 'Brankas kosong' + Add button.

screens.layout: Before auth: Clean PIN pad screen with masked input (circles). After auth: Segmented control (Sandi, Berkas). List of accounts grouped by service. For Files: Grid view of images/files. Uses brandTertiary tinted icons.

empty_tasks.alt: To do list on a piece of paper

instructions_to_main_agent: Design the app exclusively in Dark Mode per the 'Dark-First Utility DARK' personality. Do not implement a light mode toggle.
Use 'Barlow Condensed' for all major metrics, balances, and numbers to give it a tactical, dashboard-like feel.
Implement a bottom tab navigation with 4 tabs: Beranda (Home), Keuangan (Finance), Jadwal (Schedule), and Brankas (Vault).
When a user selects Brankas (Vault), the first screen must be a PIN lock entry. Only after successful PIN entry should the user see the Passwords and Files.
For the Keuangan (Finance) tab, ensure high-contrast typography for balance tracking and use segmented controls for Income/Expense.
Make sure all interactive elements are ≥44x44pt.
Render images properly using expo-image and implement a gradient-to-dark scrim pattern if text needs to sit over an image background.
Ensure the design remains 'sangat mudah digunakan' (very easy to use) by maintaining strict visual hierarchy and not overloading any single screen with unnecessary decorative chrome.
